February 26, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-26-1971-55359

* Former chief minister of East Pakistan and Pakistan National League chief Ataur Rahman in a statement says, people of East Pakistan vote for the 6-point and this is political reality. People of Bangladesh realised their sovereignty on December 7. Any effort to foil it will result in devastation.
